}}'''Lemai Ambani''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Red Ajah]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Lemai Ambani|comp}}

== History ==
Lemai spent six years as [[novice]] and eight as [[Accepted]].
She remained loyal to the [[White Tower]] during the [[White Tower Schism|White Tower schism]].

== Strength and Abilities ==
Lemai is [[Strength in the One Power among Aes Sedai|strong]] in the [[One Power]], with a strength level of {{opsl|21}}.{{ref||comp}} She is the strongest among the fifty-one Aes Sedai captured at the [[Black Tower]], with only [[Desandre Alraed]] being as strong.{{ref/book|9|p}} In the hierarchy, Lemai is slightly behind Desandre, being referred to her as "second" to her. This is because she spent longer in training.{{ref||comp}}

== Activities ==
She was one of [[Toveine Gazal]]'s group of fifty-one sisters sent by [[Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan]] to destroy the [[Black Tower]].{{ref/book|7|p}} They were all captured and bonded involuntarily by the [[Asha'man]].{{ref/book|8|26}} In particular Lemai was bonded by [[Morly Hardlin]].

Elaida abandons the Aes Sedai sent to capture the Black Tower, including Lemai, at [[Alviarin Freidhen]]'s suggestion.{{ref/book|7|32}}

[[Gabrelle Brawley]] convinces Toveine that they must publicly submit themselves to Lemai and Desandre, the two sisters who stand the highest among the captured Aes Sedai; Gabrelle says this is necessary to ensure that the captured Aes Sedai remain united.{{ref/book|9|p}}

Lemai and Desandre initiate orders that all captive sisters must achieve cordial status in the relationships with their captors in a ploy to lull the men into becoming amenable to them.{{ref/book|10|p}}

Toveine deeply dislikes taking orders from them.{{ref/book|10|p}}

As most Aes Sedai in this group it can be guessed that also Lemai was [[Turned]] to the Shadow along her Asha'man.
